title.value: AmbieGen: A Search-based Framework for Autonomous Systems Testing
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly stated in the provided information and the abstract.
title.quote: AmbieGen: A Search-based Framework for Autonomous Systems Testing

extractions.description: This paper introduces AmbieGen, a framework that uses evolutionary search to generate test cases for safety-critical autonomous systems like self-driving cars and autonomous robots. The framework is designed to identify critical scenarios through a search-based approach, enabling comprehensive and efficient testing of these systems. AmbieGen supports autonomous robots and autonomous car lane keeping assist systems by generating scenarios that reveal potential system failures. The paper provides an overview of the framework's architecture, practical use cases, and its testing capabilities.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central focus of the paper is on testing autonomous systems for robustness and functionality rather than directly addressing climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Thorough testing of safety-critical autonomous systems, such as self-driving cars, autonomous robots, and drones, is essential for detecting potential failures before deployment.
